# ===== FACT SELL-OUT (sans import) =====

t = df.copy()

# --- Periode_ID = ordre d'apparition des semaines (End week) ---
pid_map = {}
pid_counter = 1
per_ids = []
for v in t["End week"]:
    key = str(v)
    if key not in pid_map:
        pid_map[key] = pid_counter
        pid_counter += 1
    per_ids.append(pid_map[key])
t["Periode_ID"] = per_ids

# --- Distributeur / Enseigne / Canal à partir de Channel ---
distrib = []
enseigne = []
canal = []
for v in t["Channel"]:
    toks = str(v).strip().split()
    if len(toks) == 0:
        distrib.append("")
        enseigne.append("")
        canal.append("")
    else:
        d = toks[0].capitalize()
        distrib.append(d)
        enseigne.append(d)
        c = toks[-1].upper() if len(toks) > 1 else ""
        canal.append(c)
t["Distributeur"] = distrib
t["Enseigne"] = enseigne
t["Canal"] = canal

# --- Contexte constant ---
t["Marché"] = "France"
t["Région"] = "France"
t["Devise"] = "EUR"

# --- Produit & nom ---
t["ID_produit"]  = t["Finance code"].astype(str).str.strip()
t["Nom_produit"] = t["Product name"].astype(str)

# --- Nettoyage nombres FR (sans pandas top-level) ---
def _to_num_series(series):
    out = []
    for x in series:
        if x is None:
            out.append(None)
            continue
        s = str(x).replace("\u00A0", " ").replace(" ", "")
        s = s.replace(",", ".")
        try:
            out.append(float(s))
        except Exception:
            out.append(None)
    return out

t["Ventes_valeur"]     = None  # pas d'€
t["Ventes_unites"]     = _to_num_series(t["Volume sold"])
t["Ventes_volume_eq"]  = _to_num_series(t["Liters sold"])
t["Prix_moyen_unite"]  = None  # non calculable sans €

# --- Promo / Distribution : vides ---
for c in [
    "Ventes_promo_valeur","Ventes_hors_promo_valeur",
    "Ventes_promo_unite","Ventes_hors_promo_unite",
    "Ventes_promo_volume_eq","Ventes_hors_promo_volume_eq",
    "Distribution_numérique","Distribution_valeur"
]:
    t[c] = None
t["Nb_points_vente"] = [None] * len(t)

# --- Dates : on garde les chaînes source (tu n'as pas besoin de parsing ici) ---
t["Date_début"] = t["Start week week"]
t["Date_fin"]   = t["End week"]

cols = [
    "Date_début","Date_fin","Periode_ID","Distributeur","Enseigne","Canal",
    "Marché","Région","ID_produit","Nom_produit","Devise","Ventes_valeur",
    "Ventes_unites","Ventes_volume_eq","Prix_moyen_unite",
    "Ventes_promo_valeur","Ventes_hors_promo_valeur",
    "Ventes_promo_unite","Ventes_hors_promo_unite",
    "Ventes_promo_volume_eq","Ventes_hors_promo_volume_eq",
    "Distribution_numérique","Distribution_valeur","Nb_points_vente"
]

df = t.loc[:, cols]
